content:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT DETECTED: inference-cluster-eu — spike in 5xx (response errors) · alert_id=ALRT-9821 · severity=P1 · link: https://incidents.redwood.io/ALRT-9821

alex_m: seeing it, I just got paged. is this customer impacting? any obvious blast radius? :eyes:

maya: checking traffic now. initial glance — 5xx from model-host pool eu-rt-3, started ~1780054200, error rate ~18% for last 5m. some requests are timing out with kv-cache misses.

samir: quick note — im primary for this shift, tanya is secondary but she said she might be stepping out around 01:30 UTC and back by 02:10 UTC. we have a coverage gap if this turns long.

alex_m: thanks. maya — can you pull the last autoscaler events and recent rollout? run these: ```kubectl -n inference get hpa && kubectl -n inference describe deploy model-host-eu-rt-3```

maya: pasted results:
```
HPA model-host-eu-rt-3: current 6 desired 6
deploy/model-host-eu-rt-3: rollout revision 42 -> 43 at 1780054100 (failed readiness on 3/6 pods)
errors in pod model-host-eu-rt-3-43: OOMKilled on start then CrashLoopBackOff
```

samir: so a recent deploy + pod churn. could be degraded pool capacity causing high queueing -> 504s.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook pointer: /runbooks/inference/pools/high-5xx — steps 1..6. Key commands: `curl https://metrics/api?m=error_rate`, `kubectl logs -n inference <pod> --since=10m` — consult SLA impact matrix.

alex_m: customers affected? any high-traffic tenants pinned to that pool?

maya: checking routing table and tenant placement. quick query shows 3 high-tenant keys routed to eu-rt-3: customer-acme, sample-ai, analytics-pro. estimated P95 latency increased 2.3x.

alex_m: page SRE lead if this persists >10m or if any customer reports errors. per paging rules: P1 -> page primary oncall immediately, if unresolved after 15m escalate to Eng Leads (oncall rotation includes jordan as lead tonight).

samir: I already messaged tanya and jordan. tanya: are you available to take primary handoff in 20m if we need sustained mitigation?

tanya: here, I can take handoff. if we have no secondary after 01:30 UTC i'll stay reachable. page me to phone if we cross 10% customer error and >5m duration. :thumbsup:

alex_m: plan: rollback the failed revision to 42, cordon/evict bad pods, scale up spare pool if needed. maya, want me to do the rollback or you?

maya: I can kick the rollback, but will need help monitoring autoscaler. I'll run: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-host-eu-rt-3 --to-revision=42` then watch readiness and metrics.

infra-rotation-bot: Note: spare-pool-eu has 2 nodes available, can be added via `scale-pool spare-pool-eu 4` — requires manual approval (ops rotation).

samir: approve adding capacity if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 5m after rollout complete.

alex_m: executing rollback now. posting timeline: rollback start 1780054395. will update.

maya: rollback triggered 1780054395. watching pods...

oncall-bot: Deploy monitor: rollout status model-host-eu-rt-3 -> progressing, 6/6 ready? currently 4/6.

alex_m: customer comms — small customers may not notice, but we'll prepare a PSAT message in #support if impact persists. Samir, can you notify account lead for customer-acme if we still see errors after rollback?

samir: will do. I'll DM their AM and paste slack thread.

maria (external): [reaction removed] — (this message is a placeholder showing an account lead mention in DM, not a channel message)

maya: pods back to 6/6 ready at 1780054480. error rate dropped to 1.1% (baseline ~0.5%). latency P95 trending down.

alex_m: good. keep monitoring for 10m. if error rate goes above 5% for >3 continuous minutes, page secondary to phone and escalate to Jordan.

tanya: I'll be on standby for takeover at 1780055520 if needed.

samir: tagging runbook steps we followed for postmortem notes: 1) identify pool + deploy, 2) rollback, 3) add capacity if rollback fails, 4) customer comms, 5) issue trace to root cause.

alex_m: post-incident action items:
- maya: create short incident timeline and link metrics (due EOD)
- samir: confirm coverage gap mitigation for future nights (rotate secondary or ensure spare on-call)
- tanya: review the failed revision artifacts and capture any model changes that could cause OOM (assign in tracker)

ops-runbook-bot: Escalation rules (from SRE playbook):
- P1 (customer-impacting outage): page phone to primary immediately, if no ack in 2m escalate to secondary, if unresolved 15m escalate to Eng Leads and Customer Success
- P2 (degraded but partial): page Slack and SMS to secondary only, monitor 30m before pager escalation
- page list: primary oncall, secondary oncall, eng-lead rotation (jordan), infra-oncall (pager), security-oncall (if data-loss)

alex_m: closing thread for now since rollback succeeded. we'll leave monitoring open for 10m then mark incident as mitigated. thanks all. :heartpulse:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 1780054610 — error rate returned to baseline. please file postmortem if customer impact confirmed.
